name: costory
description: FinOps harness MCP for platform teams. Every cloud, data and LLM bill normalized in BigQuery and allocated to your teams. Read-only cloud access. Starter from $300/month, 30-day free trial.
suggestedPrompts: Why did our cloud bill change last week, and were there deploys in the same window?
What is our allocated spend across cloud, AI and data this month, by team?
Show the top cost drivers for the last 30 days and explain the largest increases.
